name: 33122 · Doral, FL
findings: ZIP 33122 (Doral) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33122 (Doral) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
70% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33122 (Doral) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
